note: Hard B, lineage reading: base.json names this recipe's mother (v13), so the declared difference is against that recipe -- not against the framework stock cfg, which would bury this version's own delta in everything its ancestors wrote. Two paths differ, and both are correct as defined here: the penalty term is v14.3's reason for existing, and the roll-over gate is the structural half that components.terminations resolves for v14 (no element writes it). params_version is filtered as identity, not a difference: it says which recipe this is, and it is what makes the two recipes different at all.

rewards.head_load_penalty.author: v14_head_load
rewards.head_load_penalty.why: v14.3 turns the front-plant termination into a per-step penalty, so a head-planted pose keeps its rollout data

terminations.roll_over.author: components.terminations
terminations.roll_over.why: v14.4 adds the roll-over fall gate (quaternion roll, monotone past vertical, pitch guard); a version-resolved component writes it, not an element

allowed.experiment_name: one version, one log directory (versioning.mdc A); the recipe's PPO settings are otherwise the same object as v13's, which is why this is the only agent path here

agent.why: against v13, the motherhood reading: the agent cfg is a class per version, so what it declares is its own settings changed against the version it came from. Agent entries carry no author -- there are no elements on this side, and the class is the only writer.
